app.menuHint: Press a number to jump to a category. Tab closes the menu.
app.addressPlaceholder: Paste a supported https:// or kawaikara: address
app.addressHelp: Ctrl/Cmd+L focuses this bar. Only addresses supported by an installed site are opened.
app.unsupportedAddress: This address is not supported by an installed site.
app.pictureInPictureSizeDescription: Used for landscape and square videos. Presets follow the actual ratio; Custom uses the entered size.
app.pictureInPicturePortraitSizeDescription: Used when video height exceeds width. Presets follow the portrait ratio; Custom uses the entered size.
app.pictureInPicturePositionDescription: Choose a corner for window PiP or reuse its last moved position.
app.pictureInPictureMonitorDescription: Choose where window PiP appears. A disconnected display falls back to the current display.
app.pipNoVideo: No video was found on the current page.
app.pipNotReady: The video is not ready for Picture in Picture yet.
app.pipDisabled: This video does not allow Picture in Picture.
app.pipUnsupported: Picture in Picture is not supported on this page.
app.pipFailed: Picture in Picture could not be started.
app.browserProfilesDescription: Profiles share sign-in and browser storage. Every site still runs in a fresh WebContents.
app.noUserProfiles: No user profiles have been created.
app.persistentProfile: Keeps sign-in data across app restarts.
app.siteProfileAssignmentsDescription: An isolated profile is safest. Select a shared profile only when you want sites to share sign-in state.
app.isolatedProfileDescription: Uses a persistent Session dedicated to this site.
app.drmProfileWarning: DRM site sharing can cause playback errors. An isolated profile is recommended.
app.bundlesDescription: Add .kawai Bundles containing one or more Providers and optional Plugins.
app.bundleTrustWarning: Bundles run trusted code in Kawaikara. Install only .kawai files whose publisher and contents you trust.
app.bundleInstallSuccess: {name} was installed. Restart Kawaikara to activate it.
app.noProviderSettings: This Bundle does not expose Provider settings.
app.developerToolsDescription: Inspect the currently active site view with Chrome DevTools.
app.shortFormVideoDescription: Control automatic navigation for vertical short videos and clips.
app.youtubeShortsAutoAdvanceDescription: Open the next Short after the active video really finishes.
app.chzzkClipsAutoAdvanceDescription: Open the next available Clip after the active video finishes.
app.graphicsModeDescription: Choose a mode for performance and screen-sharing or recording compatibility. Video keeps hardware decoding independently in every mode.
app.graphicsModeNativeDescription: Use the operating system's native GPU rendering. This is fastest, but video may be missing in some screen-sharing apps.
app.graphicsModeCompatibleDescription: Recommended. Keep GPU performance while rendering in a way that works better with screen sharing and recording.
app.graphicsModeSoftwareDescription: Disable GPU rendering completely. Use this when other modes have problems; Video and UI rendering can become slower.
app.graphicsRestartDescription: The rendering mode can only change at application startup. Applying it saves the other pending preferences and immediately restarts Kawaikara.
app.alwaysOnTopDescription: Keep the Kawaikara viewer above other windows.
app.openMenuOnStartupDescription: Show the site menu when Kawaikara starts.
app.closeMenuOnEscapeDescription: Close the site menu when Escape is pressed.
app.closeMenuOnOutsideClickDescription: Close the site menu when the viewer outside the menu is clicked.
app.menuOrderDescription: Choose the order of categories and sites in the menu.
app.menuOrderEditorDescription: Drag by the handle or use the arrow buttons. Changes apply after saving preferences.
app.automaticUpdatesDescription: Check at startup and ask before downloading an available update. Off by default.
app.defaultSiteDescription: The site opened when Kawaikara starts.
app.appThemeDescription: Choose the colors used by Kawaikara controls and panels.
app.appLanguageDescription: Language used by the Kawaikara interface.
app.globalLanguageDescription: This one language setting is used by the app, plugins, and sites.
app.videoSettingsDescription: Configure keyboard seeking for the internal Video view.
app.videoSeekSecondsDescription: Distance moved by Left and Right. Control uses half; Alt uses one quarter.
app.videoOverlayHideSecondsDescription: Seconds before overlay controls and the title disappear when inactive.
app.videoControlsInlineDescription: Keep the playhead visible in its own row below the video.
app.videoControlsOverlayDescription: Place the playhead over the video and hide it when inactive.
app.logLevelDescription: Choose how much diagnostic information is written to the log file.
app.logLevelErrorDescription: Record failures that prevent an operation from completing.
app.logLevelWarnDescription: Record warnings and errors that may require attention.
app.logLevelInfoDescription: Record normal app events, warnings, and errors. Recommended.
app.logLevelVerboseDescription: Record detailed operational events for closer inspection.
app.logLevelDebugDescription: Record the most detailed diagnostics for troubleshooting.
app.logLevelNoneDescription: Do not write diagnostic events to the log file.
app.videoShortcutsDescription: These shortcuts work in the internal Video view. Control and Alt provide finer time seeking.
app.shortFormVideoShortcutsDescription: Navigate short videos and toggle auto-advance. These keys also work globally while the short video is in Kawaikara PiP.
app.menuCategoryShortcutsDescription: These shortcuts only work while the site menu is open. Defaults follow the current category order.
app.shortcutCapture: Select a shortcut, then press a key combination. Backspace clears it.
app.shortcutConflictDescription: This shortcut is also assigned to {shortcuts}. Overwrite it?
app.latestVersion: You are using the latest version.
app.updateUnavailable: Update checks are available in an installed build.
app.diagnosticLogsDescription: Open the local rotating log files used for troubleshooting.

video.captureCompatibleRenderingWarning: libmpv still decodes video in hardware in capture-compatible mode. Because the Electron GPU is disabled, final frames are copied through Canvas 2D and high-resolution video may be less smooth.
